The consensus for the June data is a steady 4.0% y/y with the trimmed mean rising to 3.7% from 3.6%.

Aside from that, it's tough sledding in terms of scheduled news but all eyes will remain on South Korean stocks after the Kospi fell 10.8% yesterday.
